Response List Approvals Api Approvals Get

AgentEvent.title: AgentEvent
AgentEvent.description:
An agent timeline event. PK ``case_id``, SK ``ts#seq``.

``output`` is truncated to <=4 KB by the writer before persistence.

AgentEventType.title: AgentEventType
AgentEventType.description: Type of event recorded in the agent timeline.

Approval.title: Approval
Approval.description: A staff approval request. PK ``approval_id``; GSI ``by_status``.

ApprovalStatus.title: ApprovalStatus
ApprovalStatus.description: Status of a staff approval request.

channel.description: Channel of the first inbound message.

Case.title: Case
Case.description: A support case. PK ``case_id``; GSIs ``by_customer`` and ``by_status``.

CaseResolution.title: CaseResolution
CaseResolution.description: Resolution summary attached to a case once it is closed.

CaseStatus.title: CaseStatus
CaseStatus.description: Lifecycle status of a support case.

Channel.title: Channel
Channel.description: Messaging channel a message was sent or received on.

Customer.title: Customer
Customer.description: A customer record. PK ``customer_id``; GSI ``by_phone`` on ``phone_e164``.

DeliveryStatus.title: DeliveryStatus
DeliveryStatus.description: Delivery state of an outbound message.

MessageDirection.title: MessageDirection
MessageDirection.description: Direction of a message relative to the system.

Order.title: Order
Order.description:
An order. PK ``order_id``; GSI ``by_customer`` (``customer_id``, ``created_at``).

Derived fields (``days_late``, ``days_since_last_scan``, ``eligibility``) are NOT
stored here; they are computed by the agent at read time.

OrderItem.title: OrderItem
OrderItem.description: A single line item within an order.

at.title: At
at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the refund decision.

RefundInfo.title: RefundInfo
RefundInfo.description: Refund sub-record attached to an order once a refund is initiated.

ResolutionType.title: ResolutionType
ResolutionType.description: How a case was ultimately resolved.

ts.title: Ts
ts.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the scan.
